Container.Name: ADS-B Ultrafeeder
Container.Overview: Receive and decode ADS-B aircraft signals with an RTL-SDR or supported external input. Includes readsb, tar1090 map, graphs1090 statistics, and optional MLAT/feeder connections. No external data sharing is configured by this template.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: tar1090 aircraft map. Bridge-network host port 8080 maps to container port 80. On a custom-IP network, access the container IP on port 80.

Config.Name: Beast Output
Config.Description: Beast-format ADS-B data for existing feeder clients. On a custom-IP network, use the container IP and port 30005.

Config.Name: USB Bus
Config.Description: Mount the host USB bus so the RTL-SDR can reconnect after USB enumeration changes. Requires device cgroup rule in Extra Parameters. Review security implications: exposes host USB devices to the container.

Config.Name: Globe History
Config.Description: Persistent aircraft traces and globe history.

Config.Name: Antenna Latitude
Config.Description: Antenna latitude in decimal degrees. Required; do not publish your private antenna coordinates in a shared template.

Config.Name: Antenna Longitude
Config.Description: Antenna longitude in decimal degrees. Required.

Config.Name: Antenna Altitude
Config.Description: Antenna altitude above mean sea level with units, e.g. 125m or 410ft. Required.

Config.Name: SDR Device Type
Config.Description: Receiver type. Default: rtlsdr. For network-only ADS-B sources, consult upstream configuration.

Config.Name: RTL-SDR Serial
Config.Description: Optional RTL-SDR serial; specify when multiple compatible dongles are present.

Config.Name: RTL-SDR Gain
Config.Description: Receiver gain in dB or auto (recommended by upstream).

Config.Name: RTL-SDR PPM
Config.Description: Optional frequency correction in parts per million.

Config.Name: Enable Bias Tee
Config.Description: Enable only if your SDR and antenna amplifier require bias-tee DC power. Do not enable blindly.

Config.Name: Receiver Location Accuracy
Config.Description: Published location precision: 0=internal only; 1=approximate (2 decimals); 2=exact; 3=1 decimal; 4=0 decimals.

Config.Name: Range Statistics
Config.Description: Collect receiver range stats for tar1090 and graphs1090.

Config.Name: Map Page Title
Config.Description: Title shown on the tar1090 browser page.

Config.Name: Additional Feed Configuration
Config.Description: Optional upstream adsb/mlat/MLAT-hub configuration. Leave empty to avoid configuring outbound data sharing. See upstream docs for exact syntax.

Config.Name: MLAT Station Name
Config.Description: Optional MLAT station identifier (letters, digits, dashes, underscores); used if MLAT feeds are configured.
